abstract: Maintains safety perimeter cordon verifications and public exclusion zone records
system_message:
You are Civil defense and evacuation coordinator (CIV). As the Civil defense and evacuation coordinator (CIV), you oversee safety perimeter cordon verifications, public exclusion zone compliance, and temporary public shelter logistics for hazardous materials corridor incident response.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Temporary public shelter operations（SHEL）
information_points.content:
CIV-SHEL-BO6：Regarding temporary public shelter operations for the Pressurized high-expansion chemical foam barrier, the emergency shelter reserve capacity in designated public auditoriums outside the hazard zone is 500 beds.
CIV-SHEL-B1U：Regarding temporary public shelter operations for the Cryogenic perimeter freezing and neutralization trench, the emergency shelter reserve capacity in designated public auditoriums outside the hazard zone is 750 beds.
CIV-SHEL-XW0：Regarding temporary public shelter operations for the Modular bentonite polymer encapsulation berm, the emergency shelter reserve capacity in designated public auditoriums outside the hazard zone is 1000 beds.

information_points.title: Maintains safety perimeter cordon verifications and public exclusion zone records（EVAC）
information_points.content:
CIV-EVAC-H5I：For the Pressurized high-expansion chemical foam barrier, verification that emergency personnel have blocked all civilian road access points confirms that the perimeter isolation cordon verified status across the 800-meter public exclusion perimeter around the derailment coordinates is true.
CIV-EVAC-WOB：For the Cryogenic perimeter freezing and neutralization trench, verification that emergency personnel have blocked all civilian road access points confirms that the perimeter isolation cordon verified status across the 800-meter public exclusion perimeter around the derailment coordinates is true.
CIV-EVAC-TY8：For the Modular bentonite polymer encapsulation berm, verification that emergency personnel have blocked all civilian road access points indicates that the perimeter isolation cordon verified status across the 800-meter public exclusion perimeter around the derailment coordinates is false.
